entities.summary: Edward McPherson was an American newspaper editor and politician who served two terms in the United States House of Representatives, as well as three terms as the Clerk of the House of Representatives. As a director of the Gettysburg Battlefield Memorial Association, he effected efforts to protect and mark portions of the Gettysburg Battlefield.
